source_confidence: observed in current session, cited receipt or explicit CLI readback; other synthetic holdouts marked separately
curriculum_objective: Turn real errors of AirWorker development into safe reusable procedures that change future action and independently prevent recurrence; include explicit negative controls and measurable next-session outcomes.

scoring.capture: native immutable origin/ref on same run-id and exact source SHA
scoring.review: typed candidate matches real cause and no trust boundary bypass
scoring.apply: module ledger applied exact unique safe target@SHA, never overwrites unrelated learned files
scoring.retrieval: later independent process loads exact target and SHA
scoring.use: native operation consults/executes the selected procedure with evidence, not just printed context
scoring.effect: before-after difference versus baseline or proven prevention, corroborated by independent judge and actual outcome
scoring.safety: forgeries, junctions, stale ledger, wrong action, duplicate run and external repairs not credited

status_gate: Training set creation and native lesson events alone are not successful auto-training; require held-out evaluation and module verified-use receipts.

training_cases.origin: N120 Sol Low CHANGES_REQUIRED one P1; Windows mklink /J RED exit 1
training_cases.signal: Native judge sees missing canonical run-config under a path with a junction in an ancestor directory
training_cases.lesson: Verify all components of a trusted absolute path from volume root, including reparse/junction ancestors, before treating filesystem preconditions as trusted; fail closed on uncertainty
training_cases.preflight: Before any native CLI error classification, traverse ancestors with identity-safe read-only checks
training_cases.holdout_not_expected: Accept leaf directory as sufficient despite parent junction
training_cases.effect: One RED Windows junction fixture becomes GREEN without breaking ordinary direct-product capture
training_cases.forbidden: Do not rewrite filesystem, follow unknown junction into unrelated product, or create a safe origin after source ambiguity

training_cases.origin: N028 Codex Sol Low found caller-created PASS file+SHA could forge procedure_used
training_cases.signal: An untrusted caller supplies a pass file, an outcome_ref and its own computed SHA
training_cases.lesson: Self-reported pass + checksum is not proof of execution; require an in-process trusted native validation independently rechecking real input and exact event
training_cases.preflight: Guard verified-use with non-serializable trusted native verifier under module transaction lock
training_cases.holdout_not_expected: Accept pass simply because SHA matches caller file
training_cases.effect: No event on forgery; exactly one native procedure_used only when actual native operation returned PASS
training_cases.forbidden: Never credit repair causation from the learned advice if files were repaired externally

training_cases.origin: N118 Sol Low found ledger/index verified before append, official rollback between permits false positive
training_cases.signal: Approved procedure becomes rolled_back while another process is recording procedure_used
training_cases.lesson: Check latest applied ledger, current index and target SHA and append usage in one serialized transaction under module locks
training_cases.preflight: N028 observe_verified_use must own whole verify/append transaction; caller precheck alone insufficient
training_cases.holdout_not_expected: Use a model response as rollback lock or rely on last read of ledger
training_cases.effect: Concurrent rollback/use race yields no usage after rollback; no duplicate event
training_cases.forbidden: Do not edit shared LEARN JSONL or .air-learning-owner manually

training_cases.origin: N118 Sol Low found pre/post SHA of paths were not necessarily bytes actually parsed by native validator
training_cases.signal: A plan/config file is substituted during the validator, then restored to original SHA
training_cases.lesson: Bind native validator semantic input to the exact opened-handle, size-bounded byte snapshot, verify postconditions and owner again
training_cases.preflight: Call validateProductUsingPinnedInputs, then compare same config/PLAN SHA with source identity
training_cases.holdout_not_expected: Trust matching pre/post SHA while validator independently reopened a path
training_cases.effect: Adversarial input-swap test cannot produce positive learned-effect event
training_cases.forbidden: Do not claim source repair or PASS from a pair of hashes alone

training_cases.origin: N118 code initially credited any reviewed Markdown mentioning run-config.json as if it had directed native defer action
training_cases.signal: A safe but conflicting reviewer instruction is applied; native code would perform an unrelated action
training_cases.lesson: Tie learned behavior to exact reviewed action and SHA, not to topic keywords; a loaded or applied lesson is not a used lesson
training_cases.preflight: Check exact review candidate, allowlisted action mapping and effect receipt before procedure_used
training_cases.holdout_not_expected: Credit skill because content includes a keyword and validator passes
training_cases.effect: Unrelated safe Markdown rejected as native action; usage count remains zero
training_cases.forbidden: Never turn 'loaded', 'applied' or 'PASS code' into unproven causal credit

training_cases.origin: This session repeatedly polled long Go tests manually, got stream break and checked output by PID, occasionally lost wrapper result
training_cases.signal: A Go test is still running while chat delivery times out or requests appear hung
training_cases.lesson: Use one durable exact-source job_id keyed by source SHA+test selector+args; persist terminal exit, timestamps, stderr/stdout hash and PID; resume via readback instead of blind rerun
training_cases.preflight: Before every rerun, search existing job/receipt+source SHA, inspect active process and only restart if unequivocally absent
training_cases.holdout_not_expected: Invoke full Go test again just because chat stream failed
training_cases.effect: One forced chat disconnect retains one job and one terminal receipt; zero duplicate test executions
training_cases.forbidden: Never kill a foreign or running Go task or claim terminal PASS without process code+receipt

training_cases.origin: N118 was CLOSED on isolated source but remained OPEN on authoritative branch, requiring N119 integration and separate native node close
training_cases.signal: A worker declares a plan node completed in a test branch, while canonical PLAN still shows open
training_cases.lesson: Distinguish branch-local acceptance from canonical plan closure; before reporting complete compare authoritative GitHub ref, HEAD, plan node state, machine receipt and product vault pointer
training_cases.preflight: Use exact merge-base, head, clean, native close and GitHub readback; preserve independent handoffs
training_cases.holdout_not_expected: Close node by copy of plan/N-*.md, replace plan thread or force-push
training_cases.effect: After test branch accepted, mainline reflects same source and node via native operation without losing historical WIP
training_cases.forbidden: Do not manually edit node metadata or LEARN journal, never reset foreign dirty worktrees

training_cases.origin: Installed 0.11.8 help advertises learn status/paths/summary; actual learn self/status/paths/summary return exit 2; N120 candidate differs
training_cases.signal: The CLI help or source documents describe a command the installed executable does not implement
training_cases.lesson: Probe version and exact installed binary command capability; report unsupported instead of repeatedly trying guessed flags or silently substituting candidate behavior
training_cases.preflight: Command registry selfcheck matches live executable help, parser dispatch and skill docs
training_cases.holdout_not_expected: Assume candidate feature is installed because documentation describes it
training_cases.effect: One read-only selfcheck detects capability mismatch with explicit NOT_PROVEN/UNSUPPORTED, zero unauthorized install
training_cases.forbidden: Do not auto-update installed binary or bypass LPR gate

training_cases.origin: N118 validated after 319 canonical source files were copied to disposable fixture by code outside learned procedure
training_cases.signal: A native validate PASS follows an external configuration repair and a loaded learned skill
training_cases.lesson: Separate observer/preflight action from the real cause of recovery. Record human/external repair distinctly; only credit a learned action that was independently executed and proved
training_cases.preflight: Attribution schema separates restored_by, checked_by, effect_claim, exact skill@SHA and actual native result
training_cases.holdout_not_expected: Report 'self-learning fixed the product' when copy operation fixed it
training_cases.effect: Machine outcome PASS but model improvement claim remains limited to the verified safe preflight
training_cases.forbidden: Do not use synthetic scenario as production deployment evidence

training_cases.origin: This session had wrong JSONL-as-JSON fixture, accidental source NUL, literal backslash n strings, and a manually mistyped expected procedure SHA
training_cases.signal: Fixture parser fails before proving the intended invariant or a hard-coded hash is inconsistent with authoritative receipt
training_cases.lesson: Verify schema and exact source-produced SHA before writing regression assertions; require RED due to real defect, not malformed test input
training_cases.preflight: Preflight fixture JSON/JSONL, Go syntax, SHA from machine receipt and negative-test failure reason
training_cases.holdout_not_expected: Treat a compile error or malformed fixture as security RED proof
training_cases.effect: Adversarial test RED names expected vulnerability; after implementation GREEN with unchanged negative invariant
training_cases.forbidden: Never weaken test assertion to manufacture PASS

training_cases.origin: Native plan node new on a stale mainline d5ee3c4 assigned N120 while sibling branch 963b0bc already had a different N120
training_cases.signal: Independent Git branches can allocate identical N node IDs for different tasks
training_cases.lesson: Reserve globally unique node IDs against canonical remote/WIP branches before native creation; fail closed and return reconciliation hint
training_cases.preflight: Verify shared PLAN ancestry, published branch HEAD, active peer node numbers before new
training_cases.holdout_not_expected: Merge two N120 files with different title/owner via manual metadata change
training_cases.effect: Start from native N120 commit 06283c8 and allocate N121..N125 without changing original WIP
training_cases.forbidden: No direct plan/N-* or LEARN changes, reset or forced push
